channel.description: Opinionated, modern, pretty, and clean Zola theme.

item.title: clean functions in practice
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I keep coming back to clean functions, so here are the notes I wish I had earlier.

why it matters

Clean functions shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
